tickets.title: Organize estate settlement planning-side file
tickets.text: Organize a planning-side file for Lydia Cloudpuddle separating probate assets, beneficiary assets, estate professionals, family decision points, and household planning impacts. Lydia is co-executor with Calvin Velvetreed of Nora Velvetreed's estate, with probate handled by Sienna Bramblequill of Paper Otter Legal.

tickets.title: Resolve Missing Signature Packet
tickets.text: Use this workflow when a document packet cannot be submitted or finalized because one or more required signatures, initials, dates, attestations, or delivery acknowledgments are missing. Confirm the specific signature gap, contact the appropriate signer using approved communication channels, document the outreach, and verify the corrected packet before submission. Velvet Acorn Custody requires a certified death certificate, letters of authority, and a beneficiary claim packet before establishing Lydia Cloudpuddle's inherited IRA registration; Lydia currently has only a photocopy of the death certificate and an unsigned draft claim form.

subTasks.title: Identify the exact signature deficiency
subTasks.text: Review the packet and note each missing item: signer role, document name, page or section, required signature/initial/date, and whether a witness, notary, spouse, trustee, or authorized representative is also required. The draft beneficiary claim form for Lydia Cloudpuddle's inherited IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody is unsigned, and the death certificate is only a photocopy rather than certified.

subTasks.title: Confirm follow-up approach with advisory team
subTasks.text: Determine whether the item can be corrected electronically, requires wet ink, or needs a new form. If the missing signature affects advice, authorization, ownership, or beneficiary instructions, confirm the next step with the advisor before contacting the signer.

subTasks.title: Send signer outreach with clear instructions
subTasks.text: Contact the signer using placeholders for [client/signer name], [document name], [signature location], [return method], and [support contact]. Include only the minimum necessary document details and avoid sending sensitive information through unapproved channels.

subTasks.title: Validate corrected packet and record completion
subTasks.text: After the corrected document is received, verify all required signatures and dates are present, save the final version to the appropriate client record, update the task notes with evidence collected, and route the packet for submission or advisor review as needed.
